title: Investigation Gallery: Heuristic-driven Failure Investigation & Cost Impact Surface
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design and prototype an 'Investigation Gallery' in Redwood Console: a compact, horizontally-scrollable investigative workspace that surfaces failed requests, retry candidates, inferred error taxonomy, payload diffs, and estimated token/cost impact in a single coherent canvas. The goal is to reduce mean-time-to-investigate (MTTI) for flaky or degraded LLM responses while giving PMs and infra teams a clear cost signal tied to failure classes and rollout changes. This is a UX-first prototype that combines a timeline, failure clusters, inline payload inspector, retry-scenario simulator, and a lightweight 'Rollback / Canary' checklist integrated with rollout controls. Deliverables: interactive Figma prototype, component spec, acceptance criteria, and implementation tickets for handoff to ENG and PM.
acceptance_criteria: Compact gallery shows 1) timeline of failed requests, 2) cluster badge with inferred error class, 3) per-request payload preview with diff toggle, and 4) cost delta estimate for replaying requests.
Prototype supports 'simulate retry' that runs a mocked replay with toggles for batching and model-variant; UI shows predicted latency and token cost range.
Rollout context panel exposes active rollout, percent traffic, last config change, and a one-click 'Create rollback candidate' pre-filled with selected requests and taxonomy tags.
Design tokens and components are annotated with accessibility contrast targets and keyboard flows for quick triage (left/right to move between requests, space to open inspector).
Handoff doc links to two ENG tickets for: 1) payload diff component API and 2) cost-estimate microservice contract.
Prototype reviewed and signed off by PM (Daniel Chen) and two backend reviewers (Lucas Nguyen, Priya Shah) in this ticket's comments.
